provenance.notes: Clean-room match/handshake replies derived from the traced ROM parser (M32 phases 1-2). Request builder 35C495 sends POST /cgi-bin/dark/nph-match.cgi with X-SWAN-MTCH-ID (9 bytes from 1000:4759), MTCH-OID (9 bytes from 0000:0433, the reqmatch opponent ID), MTCH-NAME (1000:515E, %XX-encoded by 35AB3C), MTCH-CMD (decimal AX at builder entry). CMD 0/2 append a CX-byte body from ES:BX and patch Content-Length (traced: 47 field bytes -> 'Content-Length:  47', length 323; CMD 1/3/4 send headers only, length 276). Reply status is parsed by 35AEB9 (302 = retry, else continue); MTCH-RETCD by 35AFA8 into [SS:0x3B1]; MTCH-POLINT/MTCH-TIMEOUT by 35AFA8 into [0x398]=n*75/[0x39A]=n*75. Traced dialogue (each step verified natively with AL=9): wrapper 35C7B0 sends CMD 0 until RETCD 0 then CMD 1 until RETCD 2; 35C8F2 sends CMD 2 until RETCD 3; 35C9A7 sends CMD 3 (RETCD 4 waits) until RETCD 5; 35CA60 sends CMD 4 until RETCD 6; missing RETCD stores 9 and fails with AL=0xFF. For RETCD 2/5 the parser copies [0x3AB] (Content-Length) bytes from after the LF blank line to the caller buffer ES:[0x3B6] (traced 1021-byte copy). Numbers stop only at space/LF and the body search needs an LF blank line, so the original format is LF-only; with CRLF the count corrupts to L*10+221 (word) and the copy source misses (both traced). This static route serves the dialogue-entry step (RETCD 0 for CMD 0); a live server must sequence RETCD 0/2/3/5/6 per CMD as documented (per-phase probe definitions are archived with the M32 runs). Body length 80 keeps the corrupted count (253) past the response end. All match values here are newly authored PLACEHOLDERS; original pairing policy and battle-payload contents remain unknown.
